title: DORA 2025: Measuring Software Delivery After AI
summary: RedMonk explains DORA 2025's switch to archetypes and its AI findings: throughput and most outcomes up, stability still worse.

assertions.quote: AI improves outcomes at nearly every level except system stability.
AI has a negative impact on throughput, stability, and time spent on valuable work.

verdicts.note: DORA's 2024 survey estimates that each 25% increase in AI adoption is associated with about 1.5% lower delivery throughput and 7.2% lower delivery stability, contrary to the authors' expectations; an association in survey data, not a causal estimate.

assertions.quote: only a paradox if you assume individual productivity automatically improves system performance
In 2025, 90% of respondents reported using AI within their job function

verdicts.note: DORA's 2024 survey found toil and burnout essentially unchanged with AI adoption (burnout about -0.6% per 25% more adoption), saying AI is not helping with meetings, bureaucracy and other toil; survey associations.
